reason: The nauty FFI bench comparator is an oracle, not part of the factorization service call graph: no factorization benchmark links it or calls it, and the fingerprint reaches it only because Hex/*.lean spans the whole tree. This edit splits the comparator's marshalling out of its timed region and widens its wire format; it cannot move any factorization curve. The same note in FACTOR_LIBRARIES already records that Hex/BenchOracle belongs to the oracles and that splitting it out is worth doing.
